summary: Kern County built this enclosed timber lookout between Tehachapi and Keene around 1940; it is now on Nature Conservancy land, which lists limited access.

facts.design: 12x12 ft cabin on a 20-ft enclosed timber tower

access.note: The land is part of The Nature Conservancy's preserve, which lists limited access. The June 2022 assessment visit was by permission.

visit.trail_note: Lookout is north of Highway 58 near the head of Tollgate Canyon; the Conservancy lists limited access, so ask before going near it.

events.note: Newspaper notice (June 12, 1936) said two lookout stations would be erected, one at Tollgate. Planned only; the built year is not given in that notice.
Built by the Kern County Fire Department, circa 1940 per the register; the Tehachapi News says it is believed built in 1940.
A 50-acre fire on the Carl Arnold Ranch was under control in under three hours; the Tollgate lookout's smoke report was credited.
Register says the lookout was staffed through at least 1965. The Tehachapi News says staffing ran sometimes into the 1970s.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on May 27, 2022.
Forest Fire Lookout Association and Buck Rock Foundation group visited with permission on June 26, 2022 to document and assess the building.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says circa 1940 and the Tehachapi News says believed built in 1940. A 1936 newspaper notice planned a Tollgate lookout, and a June 1940 item lists a 'Toll gate lookout' among new items at $750. The record keeps 1940.
The register says staffed through at least 1965; the Tehachapi News says staffed until sometimes in the 1970s. The story reports both.
The register gives 5,593 ft (1,705 m); the Tehachapi News says about 5,700 ft. The record keeps the register's 1,704.7 m.
The Tehachapi News feature gives the Frank and Joan Randall Preserve as 81,000 acres; the Conservancy's page says over 70,000 acres. Not a record field; noted for the story only.

notes_for_editor: Build year is circa 1940 (register) and believed 1940 (Tehachapi News); the California lookouts history page quotes a June 1936 notice planning a Tollgate lookout, so the first plan may predate the 1940 build. Staffing status is 'unknown': no page states today's status. 'unstaffed' would only be an inference from the Tehachapi News wording that staffing ran until the 1970s. The 1954 fire is quoted from a newspaper transcription on the California lookouts page (Bakersfield Californian), not the original paper. The preserve acreage differs between sources. The article's own date is not shown in pages read; the 2022 dates come from the register's photo captions.
